Scripts.OnLoad:
Mixin(self, AuctionatorConfigTooltipMixin) Mixin(self, AuctionatorConfigMoneyInputMixin)
self:SetScript("OnUpdate", function(frame) local frameName = frame:GetName()
-- Primero intenta resolver los elementos por nombre. if frameName then frame.MoneyInput = frame.MoneyInput or _G[frameName .. "MoneyInput"]
frame.Label = frame.Label or _G[frameName .. "Label"] end
-- Para controles anónimos, obtiene el MoneyInput desde los hijos. if not frame.MoneyInput then local children = { frame:GetChildren() }
for _, child in ipairs(children) do if child and child.GetObjectType and child:GetObjectType() == "Frame" then frame.MoneyInput = child break end end end
-- Obtiene la etiqueta del control. if not frame.Label then local regions = { frame:GetRegions() }
for _, region in ipairs(regions) do if region and region.GetObjectType and region:GetObjectType() == "FontString" then frame.Label = region break end end end
if not frame.MoneyInput then return end
local moneyName = frame.MoneyInput:GetName()
-- En controles nombrados, intenta resolver los editboxes globales. if moneyName then frame.MoneyInput.GoldBox = frame.MoneyInput.GoldBox or _G[moneyName .. "Gold"]
frame.MoneyInput.SilverBox = frame.MoneyInput.SilverBox or _G[moneyName .. "Silver"] end
-- Para controles anónimos, busca los EditBox entre sus hijos. if not frame.MoneyInput.GoldBox or not frame.MoneyInput.SilverBox then local editBoxes = {} local moneyChildren = { frame.MoneyInput:GetChildren() }
for _, child in ipairs(moneyChildren) do if child and child.GetObjectType and child:GetObjectType() == "EditBox" then table.insert(editBoxes, child) end end
frame.MoneyInput.GoldBox = frame.MoneyInput.GoldBox or editBoxes[1]
frame.MoneyInput.SilverBox = frame.MoneyInput.SilverBox or editBoxes[2] end
if not frame.MoneyInput.GoldBox or not frame.MoneyInput.SilverBox then return end
frame:SetScript("OnUpdate", nil)
if not frame.__auctionatorMoneyInputLoaded then frame.__auctionatorMoneyInputLoaded = true frame:OnLoad() end end)
